trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum itself: it unlocks on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is nothing separate to do for it. Plan the run around A Long Road (100% completion) and the single missable, Positive Mental Attitude, and this one looks after itself.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: A story trophy for finishing Gone Fishing, the opening mission of the game. It cannot be missed: simply play through the introduction and it pops as the mission wraps up.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 of the story. Before you leave this chapter behind, deal with the game's one missable moment: after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia's meditation invitation at Jason's house (see Positive Mental Attitude). Everything else in the chapter can be revisited in free-roam later.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2 of the story. Story progress is never locked out — there is no mission replay, but chapter trophies pop as you play through the campaign in order.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 of the story. Keep scanning new vehicles and animals as you travel between missions — progress toward Whip It Good and the 100% checklist accrues as you go.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 of the story. Some stranger quest givers become temporarily unavailable around late-story beats; if a strand you need has vanished from the map, push the story forward and check back.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final story mission (the Chapter 5 finale). The game continues in free-roam afterwards and everything the 100% checklist needs stays accessible, so leave the big cleanup grinds until after this pops.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run during Chapter 1. It is a main-path mission, so it cannot be missed on the way through the chapter.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist, a set-piece story mission. There are no mission gold medals in this game, so a clean finish — not a perfect one — is all the trophy asks for.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play as it arrives in the campaign. Main-path and unmissable.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Like every named-mission trophy on this list it is tied to the main path and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown at the airport. Main-path and unmissable — and a useful early look at VCIA, which Catch Me If You Can sends you back to later.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Main-path and unmissable.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The long haul of the platinum: fill the in-game 100% Completion checklist, found under Progress > Stats once the story is done. The checklist is more forgiving than it sounds — guides estimate it asks for roughly 60% of everything the game tracks, and progress you make during the story already counts. PowerPyx puts the whole platinum at about 200 hours, most of it here; leave this grind until after the finale, when the checklist becomes viewable.
steps: Finish the story first — the 100% checklist only becomes viewable afterwards.
Work the checklist categories in order: story, strangers, challenges, collectibles.
Use this tracker to keep the trophy counters (stunts, races, cards) moving alongside it.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 of the stunt jumps scattered across Leonida. They are marked in the world once found and your total is tracked in the Progress menu, so the efficient play is to clear them region by region while you explore rather than in one dedicated grind. A fast car or bike and a clear run-up matter more than speed at the ramp — you need a clean landing for the stunt to count.
steps: Sweep one region at a time and tick stunts off as you land them.
If a jump keeps failing, change vehicle before you change line — weight and wheelbase change the flight.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample every activity type once: a race, a Shooting Range challenge, a fishing spot, an arcade game, a drone race and the rest of the map's activity icons. You only need to try each type, not win it, so run this sampler early — it also teaches you where everything lives for the trophies that do demand wins.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold-medal all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Medals are score-based, so learn a challenge's target pattern with a practice run, then chase gold once the rhythm is familiar. Accuracy streaks pay better than raw speed on most ranges — steady fire beats spraying.
steps: Run each challenge once to learn its target order before going for gold.
Replay immediately while the pattern is fresh rather than moving on.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win the Top Fun drone race at every location that hosts one. Each course is a checkpoint run: fly the gates in order and protect your line through the tight sections rather than chasing top speed on the straights. If a location keeps beating you, learn its final three gates — races here are usually lost at the end, not the start.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — distinct events, so repeating your favourite circuit does not add to the counter. Work through the race icons on the map, bring a vehicle suited to each class, and let the tracker count the wins as you clear them.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal, the fishing rival, in one of his fishing challenges. Accept the challenge at a fishing spot and out-catch him before the timer ends — steady reeling on hooked fish beats frantic casting, and losing costs nothing but a rematch.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one game on any arcade cabinet. Walk up to a machine in an arcade or bar, play it through to completion, and the trophy pops — the quickest single stop on the whole list.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's stranger mission strand: work through each of his missions as his icon appears until the final one is done. If his icon disappears mid-strand, he is only temporarily unavailable — some quest givers pause during story beats and return afterwards.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's stranger mission strand. Kenton is the quest giver the roadmap guides specifically warn about: he becomes temporarily unavailable during parts of the story, so if his missions vanish, progress the campaign and check back rather than assuming the strand is lost.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's stranger mission strand, completing each of his missions through to the final one. One of the eight strands Strangers & Freaks counts.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight full stranger mission strands anywhere in Leonida. Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone each carry a strand with its own trophy, so finishing those five puts you most of the way there; the remaining strands come from the other stranger icons that appear as you explore. A strand only counts when its final mission is done.
steps: Clear the five named strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) — each also earns its own trophy.
Pick up three more strands from stranger icons while exploring.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's stranger mission strand through to his final mission. One of the eight strands Strangers & Freaks counts.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's stranger mission strand through to his final mission. One of the eight strands Strangers & Freaks counts.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot in Leonida — 18 in all — and treat the very first one as the whole trophy's weak point. In Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia is at Jason's house in the morning and says she is going to meditate: follow her onto the balcony and choose Accept. That session counts toward the total but is not marked like the open-world spots, and the moment passes when the chapter ends. Whether it is strictly required is still unconfirmed, but every major guide flags it as the game's one potentially missable trophy, and the authors who did it earned the trophy — so do it. The remaining spots are ordinary free-roam stops you can clear any time.
steps: Chapter 1, after Down to Earth: go to Jason's house in the morning.
Find Lucia in the kitchen, follow her to the balcony and choose Accept when she offers to meditate.
Afterwards, meditate at every marked spot across Leonida — the counter in this tracker keeps your place.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Take Bret's hunting request and bring down the unique animal he sends you after. Track the target in its territory rather than chasing it across the map — a patient approach from cover lands the shot. Which animal it is was still unconfirmed in launch-week guides, so follow Bret's in-game directions when the hunt opens.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any three full sets of the collectible cards hidden around Leonida. Cards sit in the kinds of places this series loves — counters, shelves, back rooms and scenic stops — so check interiors while you travel. Focus on finishing sets rather than scattering pickups: a completed set is what the counter rewards.
steps: Pick one set and sweep its cards region by region.
Tick sets off in the tracker as each one completes — three finished sets pop the trophy.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK spot at 100 different locations around Leonida. The spots are fixed points of interest spread across the whole state, so this is a tour as much as a collectible hunt: clear them district by district alongside The Goodtime State's exploration and the stunt jumps, and keep the counter in this tracker updated so no district gets half-done twice.
steps: Work district by district and log each spot as you use it.
Pair the sweep with stunt jumps and map exploration in the same trip.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the game's challenges. The game tracks 80, and the platinum roadmaps aim for about 70 of them on the way to 100% completion, so this trophy lands naturally if you work the challenge list during Stage 3 — pick off the short ones first and let the counter climb.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, raise the heat to a 4-star wanted level, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars drain away completely. Do it somewhere with alleys, garages or countryside nearby rather than an open highway — you need somewhere to disappear to once the chase peaks.
steps: Pick up your partner and cause enough trouble to reach 4 stars.
Break away, hide out of sight, and wait for the wanted level to fully clear.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops in one unbroken run with your partner along, never letting the wanted level fully drop between hits. Plan the route first: choose three shops close together in one district, rob the first, and move straight to the next while the heat is still on you. A fast car waiting outside each door keeps the chain alive.
steps: Scout three shops close together and park a getaway car outside the first.
Rob each in turn, never letting the stars disappear between shops.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles — a model registers the first time you get in and drive it. You will pass the halfway mark just by varying your rides during the story; after that, sweep car parks, marinas, airfields and rich districts for the models you have not sat in yet, and note finds in the tracker so you stop re-checking the same cars.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Drop five enemies during one Combat Focus activation. Set it up before you trigger it: draw a group of enemies into the open — a gang operation or a robbery gone loud works well — position yourself with all five in view, then activate Focus and work left to right without pausing.
steps: Gather five or more enemies in one open area.
Trigger Combat Focus once, and take down five before it ends.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: VCIA is the airport: an 'unscheduled departure' means leaving in an aircraft that was never yours. GTABase's reported method is to steal a docked passenger jet on the apron and fly it roughly a kilometre away from the field, at which point the trophy pops.
steps: Get airside at VCIA and find a docked passenger jet.
Take it, get airborne, and put about a kilometre between you and the airport.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description is the riddle: a Rhino is the series' tank, and it gets hot inside one. GTABase's reported solution is to steal a Rhino from Mile Zero Air Station and take out enemies while sitting in it. Expect serious resistance at the base — go in with full health and an exit in mind, though once you are in the tank the resistance matters a lot less.
steps: Enter Mile Zero Air Station and reach a Rhino tank.
Get in and defeat enemies from inside the tank.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Clean out a jewelry store without ever being detected — no alarm tripped, no witness completing a call. Move quietly, watch staff sightlines, and take the discreet exit rather than the front door. If you are spotted, walk away and try another store rather than forcing it; detection voids only that attempt.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and get away cleanly each time — a robbery only counts once you have escaped the heat. Plan the exit before you enter: a fast car parked facing out, and a route that leaves the district quickly. Space the five out between other activities so the grind never stalls on one bad escape.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Hold up an armored truck on its route, take the cash, and escape the response. The rear doors are the weak point — stop the truck somewhere you control, open it up fast, and leave on a route you have already picked. The trophy needs the escape, not just the robbery.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Uncover the whole map of Leonida by visiting every part of the state. This pairs naturally with the WAiNK spots, stunt jumps and vehicle hunting: tour the map region by region, including the keys and the far corners the story never sends you to, and the trophy pops when the last patch of fog lifts.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Hit an illegal operation run by each of Leonida's gangs — one per gang, not the same crew five times. As you learn which territory belongs to whom, rob one operation in each gang's turf and note them here so you can see which colours are still missing.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: A quiet one: order a cocktail at Ocean Beach and drink in the view. Launch-week guides list it with its exact steps still unconfirmed, so treat it as an Ocean Beach stop — find the beachfront bar spot, buy the drink, and let the moment play out. It costs two minutes whenever you are first in the area.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Get into a car inside a vehicle showroom and drive it straight out through the showroom glass. 'In classic style' is the series' oldest joke — the car leaves through the window, not the door. Pick a car near the glass, get in, and floor it.
steps: Enter a vehicle showroom and get into a display car.
Drive it out through the glass frontage.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go bowling at the Kolt & Associates alley and complete your throw — the 'follow-through' is finishing the bowling action at that specific alley. It is a two-minute stop once you find the lanes; guides list the exact wording as slightly unclear, so play a full game there to be safe.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A hidden trophy the lists tie to Jason and Lucia's partnership in the story. Launch-week guides had not published a separate method beyond its description, so the practical advice is simple: keep playing the story with both protagonists and do not skip their joint scenes — it is reported among the hidden story trophies, not the free-roam feats.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: A hidden story trophy about the choices the campaign puts in front of you. No guide flags it as missable, and none had pinned down a required 'right' choice at launch — play the story, make your calls as they come, and it resolves through story progress.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: A hidden feat built around failing once and succeeding on the retry — 'second time's the charm' is the whole instruction the game gives. Launch-week guides had not confirmed the exact trigger, so keep it in mind whenever an activity lets you retry immediately: a failed attempt followed by a successful one is the shape of it.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: The list's UFO-flavoured riddle trophy — even its description is a reaction, not an instruction. KeenGamer's roadmap lists its unlock method as unconfirmed, and no guide had a verified solution at launch, so this entry deliberately stays with what the description supports: something strange is out there in Leonida, and encountering it is the trophy. Watch the night skies and odd lights; when a verified method is published, the sources below are where it will appear.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: From a moving vehicle, strike pedestrians or enemies with a melee weapon as you pass — bowling them over is the trophy. Line up a group on a pavement or at a gathering spot, keep the car at a steady roll rather than full speed so the swing connects, and drive through the group.
steps: Equip a melee weapon and find a group of people on foot.
Drive past at a steady pace and swing as you pass through the group.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Turn $250,000 of Marked Bills into clean money through your laundering contacts. Marked bills come from scores like the vault and truck robberies in this list, so this trophy is the sequel to your robbery route: after each big job, move the marked cash to a contact instead of sitting on it, and log the running total here until the quarter-million is clean.
steps: Collect Marked Bills from robberies (bank vaults, armored trucks).
Deliver them to your laundering contacts — repeat until $250,000 is laundered.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a cumulative $100,000 in shops — clothes, weapons, vehicle work, supplies, everything counts toward the one total. It accumulates naturally across a 200-hour platinum run; if it is somehow still short at the end, a vehicle customisation spree closes the gap quickly.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy every garage property on the map. Garages appear as property purchases as you explore; sweep them up during the Stage 4 collectibles tour, funding them from the robbery route — each purchase also gives your growing vehicle collection somewhere to live.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Whenever you acquire a vehicle you intend to keep, register it in the app before you move on — ten registrations is a small ask spread over a full run, and the counter here keeps you honest.
